steps.text: Peel the potatoes and cut into uniform 1/2-inch pieces.  Cover, set over high heat, and bring to a boil.
Place into a 4-quart saucepan and cover with cold water by at least 1 inch.
Once boiling, remove the lid, decrease the heat to maintain a simmer, and cook until the potatoes can easily be crushed with a pair of tongs, 15 to 20 minutes.
Put the cream, butter, salt, and pepper into the now-empty 4-quart saucepan and place back over the heat until the butter has melted.
Remove from the heat and set a food mill fitted with the smallest die on top of the pot. Add 1 cup of potatoes to the mill at a time. (or just use a potato masher)
Once all of the potatoes have passed through the mill, stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning, if desired. Serve immediately.
